headline: Bitcoin Dips Following Attacks on Binance and Mercado Bitcoin
summary: Bitcoin traded lower following security attacks on cryptocurrency exchanges Binance and Brazil's Mercado Bitcoin, which reported losses of $50 million.
why: Cryptocurrency exchange security breaches can impact digital asset liquidity, investor confidence, and short-term token pricing.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Security breaches at major exchanges negatively affect broader crypto market sentiment and token prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Security incidents targeting major crypto platforms stoked risk aversion across digital asset markets, pushing Bitcoin lower.
